offers_products.reason: Manufactures RVs: travel trailers, fifth wheels, motorhomes under Airstream, Jayco, Heartland and other brands.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from building and selling RVs; service is only warranty or support tied to vehicles sold.

sells_to_consumers.reason: RV buyers are families and individuals who choose the brand, though they buy through dealers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells RVs wholesale to independent dealers, which buy them for resale.

recurring_revenue.reason: RVs are bought once every few years; sales are one-off vehicle purchases, not subscriptions or consumables.

cyclical_demand.reason: Recreational RVs are discretionary purchases that buyers and dealers can easily postpone in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: A motorhome, fifth wheel or travel trailer is a large, infrequent purchase for a household.

people_delivered.reason: It is a manufacturer; customers pay for finished RVs, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: End buyers are households, and dealers are mostly independent businesses, not large enterprises or government.

asset_heavy.reason: Operates many RV manufacturing plants and needs ongoing capital investment in facilities and equipment.
